output.summary: A tiny aquatic flowering plant native to Europe, Africa and parts of Asia, rootless duckweed is described as Earth’s smallest vascular plant. Its rootless, rounded green body floats on quiet water and buds into new plants. Long used as inexpensive food in Myanmar, Laos and Thailand, it is rich in protein and starch.
output.edibilityNote: Long used as inexpensive food in Myanmar, Laos and Thailand; its green part is protein-rich and its dormant turions are starch-rich.
